title: Implement reusable definition update and rename
description: Add provider update behavior for reusable definitions after catalog create/read support exists. Accept partial name, title, and instructions changes with at least one field supplied; preserve ID and createdAt, advance updatedAt monotonically, and atomically replace the validated catalog. A rename must keep every task reference valid because tasks store UUIDs. Enforce case-insensitive name uniqueness while allowing casing-only edits to the same definition. Return unchanged results consistently when supplied values normalize to stored values. Add focused tests for rename stability, partial edits, casing-only updates, no-op handling, duplicate-name rejection, timestamp behavior, and injected atomic-write failure. Do not implement deletion or task detachment here.
